verdict.rationale: Finix documents a platform-payments model: it onboards sellers, routes payments and payouts to them (via Dashboard or API), and lets the platform monetize payments through configurable fees. That covers routing funds to sellers and taking a platform cut at a basic level. Nothing in the pack shows splitting a single charge across several parties as a first-class API object, or reversing or adjusting a split afterward. missing for 10: explicit multi-party split of one charge, split reversal/adjustment, split as a first-class API object, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
